entities.name: Bromobutyl lactam substrate
observations: SELFIES decode to O=C1Nc2ccc(Br)c3c2C1(CCCCBr)CCC3, a brominated lactam with a terminal primary 4-bromobutyl group.
The molecule contains an aryl bromide and a lactam NH in addition to the terminal alkyl bromide.

entities.name: Fused bicyclic secondary amine
observations: The aliphatic secondary amine is more nucleophilic than the indole-like [nH] nitrogen under the stated conditions.

entities.name: K2CO3 in N-methylacetamide
observations: Dip potassium carbonate and N-methylacetamide are consistent with base-promoted SN2 N-alkylation of a primary bromide.

observations: The reaction database returned an exact core-reactant match.
The proposed transformation replaces the terminal alkyl C-Br bond with a C-N bond to the aliphatic nitrogen of the fused bicyclic amine.

entities.name: N-alkylated tethered product
observations: The product retains the aryl bromide, lactam NH, and indole-like [nH], while forming a tertiary aliphatic amine.
